page_title: BAR 4-1 VIL | Barcelona v Villarreal 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
90+5' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Barcelona.
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Barcelona players have a reason to celebrate!
90+2' The Barcelona players joy may have been justified, because referee Isidro Diaz is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+1' 4 - 1 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Jules Kounde. The score is 4:1.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' It looks like Pau Navarro (Villarreal) saw red with that tackle. Isidro Diaz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
86' Fermín (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) replaces Nicolas Pepe.
83' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Fermín (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Barcelona earn a corner.
80' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Santi Comesana.
80' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) replaces Sergi Cardona.
77' A dangerous towering header by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
76' Corner kick. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
74' The attendance for today's match is 44256.
73' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
73' The substitution has been made. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) has replaced Raphinha.

71' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Joan Garcia anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
69' 3 - 1 Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) scores a goal! He latches onto a lovely pass that puts him one-on-one with the keeper before producing a fine strike that goes into the left side of the net!
68' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) receives a yellow card.
67' Substitution. Ayoze Perez is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
67' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) replacing Marc Bernal.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) will replace Ferran Torres.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alberto Moleiro as he is replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
67' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Luiz Junior.
61' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
59' It's time for a substitution. Pedri (Barcelona) comes on in place of Dani Olmo.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.
55' Hansi Flick appears to have said too much and referee Isidro Diaz comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
55' Referee Isidro Diaz has finally had enough of Marcelino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
54' It looked like the long-range shot by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
53' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Marc Bernal (Barcelona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
52' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

49' 2 - 1 Goal! Santiago Mourino manages to prod the ball to Pape Gueye (Villarreal) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
48' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
47' Great chance! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
44' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
44' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

43' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires the resulting free kick to the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but Luiz Junior pulls off a superb save to deny him. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) makes a slide tackle, but referee Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.

41' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
40' Fermín (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

37' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top left corner and makes it 2:0. Luiz Junior was helpless.
36' The game is interrupted as Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is flagged offside.
35' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
33' Flag up against Ayoze Perez (Villarreal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Fermín provides Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
26' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz no option but to blow his whistle.
26' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

24' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Luiz Junior makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
20' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' A clever short pass gives Jules Kounde (Barcelona) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
13' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Marc Bernal (Barcelona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
12' Fermín (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
12' A corner kick by Villarreal is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Barcelona).
11' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
9' Dani Olmo receives a sweet pass inside the box from Raphinha (Barcelona), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

3' Fermín (Barcelona) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
